title: Grateful Dead Live at War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a fire‑filled Rochester 1982 show with a sweet Brokedown Palace encore.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clean, clear and crispy soundboard quality, though a few note it doesn’t fully convey the on‑stage energy. The performance itself is described as "on fire" from the start, with the encore of "Brokedown Palace" highlighted as especially sweet. Overall the show and its remastering by C. Miller are well regarded.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars, emphasizing excellent soundboard quality and high‑energy performance; only one outlier rating is low and does not detract from the overall positive consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crispy, clean, clear board with excellent C. Miller remaster; some comment that it doesn’t fully capture the venue’s energy but no major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, high‑energy start that kept momentum throughout; encore singled out for its sweetness.
